description.tr: Fazilet sahibi, Ezher'de tahsil gördü, Gazze Ulu Camii'nde öğretim görevini yüklendi.
description.en: A scholar of virtue, educated at al-Azhar, he took on teaching at the Great Mosque of Gaza.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn al-ʿAlmī al-Ḥasanī nasaban al-Ghazzī mawlidan al-Dimashqī istiqrāran wa-wafātan

tr: Abdullâh b. Muhammed b. Salâhiddîn Alemî Hasenil-nesebi Gaziyyu'l-mevlidî Dımaşkiyyu'l-istikrâr ve'l-vefâ
ar: عبد الله بن محمد بن صلاح الدين العلمي ، الحسني نسبا، الغزي مولدا، الدمشقي استقرارا ووفاة
